newsitem.title: USA: Gander Mountain reorganization plan wins court nod.
newsitem.headline: Gander Mountain reorganization plan wins court nod.

text.p: Gander Mountain Inc said Thursday that the U.S. Bankruptcy Court has confirmed the company's reorganization plan.
Yesterday, creditors and shareholders of the company voted in favor of the plan's approval.

"We are pleased to have completed this long and difficult process. Creditors and shareholders will receive a return on their investment according to the priority order described in the plan," said Ralph Freitag, Gander Mountain chief executive offier, in a statement.

The reorganization plan was jointly proposed by Holiday Companies, Gander Mountain and the official creditors' committee. Holiday Companies is a privately-held Bloomington, Minn. based retailer and wholesaler of outdoor and other sporting goods as well as gasoline and food products.
With the acquisition of the 12 Gander Mountain stores, Holiday's outdoor sporting goods group will consist of 26 retail stores in four states.
Gander Mountain is a specialty retailer serving the outdoor recreation market.
